newsitem.title: CHINA: Cheung Kong Infrastructure in China water plant JV.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong Infrastructure in China water plant JV.

text.p: Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd (CKI) said on Wednesday it has signed a contract to invest in the Xiejiang Water Plant in Jiangmen, in southern Chinese Guangdong province.
The investment comes up to a total of 220 million yuan, of which CKI will fork out 49 percent and the joint venture will last 18 years, it said in a statement.
CKI did not say who its partners were.
The deal follows CKI's participation in two other water plant contracts in Shenyang city last week.
